connections.edgeLabel: a company stood up to hold a single government contract
connections.label: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS), LLC
connections.note: BAASS was registered as a legal entity distinct from Bigelow Aerospace, with its own DUNS and CAGE codes, in order to bid and hold DIA contract HHM402-08-C-0072. Standing up a corporate vehicle for the purpose of receiving one award is a contracting mechanic, and it is the one instance on this board that is fully documented in FOIA-released procurement paper.

connections.edgeLabel: contracting at a site whose existence was itself classified
connections.label: EG&G (Edgerton, Germeshausen and Grier)
connections.note: EG&G instrumented and fired US nuclear tests from the Manhattan Project onward and became the classified services contractor for the Nevada complex, including the Air Force operating location near Groom Lake - a facility whose existence required a Presidential Determination published at 60 FR 52823 to exempt it from disclosure. It is the historical template for how contracting works where the place of performance cannot be named.

It is also the only company named on the floor of a congressional hearing by a sworn witness in connection with the custody allegation, which makes it the test case for whether contracting records can be made to answer the question.

connections.edgeLabel: the largest operator of the one acquisition form built to be non-competitive by design
connections.label: The MITRE Corporation
connections.note: MITRE operates multiple FFRDCs. FAR 35.017 permits an agency to meet special long-term research needs through a sponsoring agreement with a single operator outside full and open competition, and obliges the FFRDC to disclose its activities to its sponsor and to no one else. That is a contracting mechanism, and MITRE is its largest single instance.

connections.edgeLabel: a non-FAR instrument binding the Army to a private claimant of recovered material
connections.label: CRADA between U.S. Army Ground Vehicle Systems Center and To The Stars Academy
connections.note: Signed 10 October 2019 by the Director of the Army Ground Vehicle Systems Center and announced 17 October 2019. A Cooperative Research and Development Agreement sits outside ordinary procurement, involves no exchange of appropriated funds to the partner, and protects the private party's proprietary data - which is exactly the class of vehicle this domain is about. The executed document is not public; sourcing is the partner's own contemporaneous FAQ.

desc: Follow the contract vehicle and you find the programme, which is why acquisition mechanics belong on an intelligence board. The routes that matter here are the ones with reduced visibility: sole-source justifications under exceptions to full and open competition; Cooperative Research and Development Agreements, which allow a government laboratory to work with a private party on terms that protect the private party's proprietary data; Other Transaction Authority, which sits outside the Federal Acquisition Regulation entirely; and classified contract line items that appear in financial systems only as an obligation figure. The documented case study is the Army's 2019 CRADA with To The Stars Academy to evaluate materials for combat vehicle applications - an agreement reported by Bloomberg Government and examined by The War Zone, in which the mechanism was used for exactly this subject matter in the open. The AAWSAP file shows the ordinary route: a solicitation, a competitive award, priced modifications, and deliverables. Scoring high on this domain means an entity signs, awards or administers these instruments.
